deployments_detail.use: "Magic Apron" GenAI assistant (project guidance, product Q&A) + agentic AI tools for associates/pros (Google Cloud)

Sidekick associate app: cloud-based machine-learning task-prioritization plus computer vision that flags out-of-stock shelves and locates overhead inventory, running on custom hdPhones to improve on-shelf availability across US stores. [In-house ML; hardware with Zebra Technologies, HPE, Aruba]
deployments_detail.value: ~100 bps on-shelf availability improvement worth several hundred million dollars in sales lift (Constellation Research); 99,000+ hdPhones deployed

deployments_detail.use: Order Intelligence: delivery-logistics AI that analyzes millions of historical delivery data points to assign risk scores, account for site-access issues, and recommend the right delivery vehicle size.
Microsoft Copilot deployed to office/corporate workers as a productivity assistant. [Microsoft Copilot]
Anthropic's Claude used as an AI coding assistant supporting Home Depot's software development. [Anthropic Claude]

Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) strategy to make Home Depot products discoverable and recommended within third-party AI shopping assistants such as ChatGPT and Gemini. [OpenAI ChatGPT, Google Gemini (external platforms)]

Magic Apron: customer-facing generative AI assistant on homedepot.com product pages and the mobile app that answers how-to/project questions, recommends tools and materials, calculates material quantities, and summarizes product reviews; expanding to Pro contractors and store/contact-center associates. [Proprietary LLM trained on Home Depot knowledge base; Google Cloud (Gemini Enterprise)]
Intent Search: AI-enhanced on-site search capability rolled out as part of Home Depot's generative-AI suite to better interpret shopper intent.

AI customer-service voice/phone agent that lets callers skip phone-tree menus and describe their need in natural language, piloted in stores; demonstrated identifying the caller's intent within about 10 seconds. [Google Cloud (Gemini Enterprise for Customer Experience)]
deployments_detail.value: understands what a customer is calling about in ~10 seconds
